section_summary.extract_value: This section presents descriptive statistics for a single study with a total sample of N = 490 participants. Table 1 reports means, standard deviations, and intercorrelation scores between six measures: BMI, EMWSS, EMWSS_peers, SSPS, BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale), and EDE-Q. The correlation between Body Appreciation (BAS-2) and BMI is -0.37 (p < .001), indicating a significant negative relationship.
